MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful next addition because its larger screen could let me view my Blink camera if compatible while adding Alexa control to my Fire TV setup.",
    "The smart plug gives my connected-home setup a new practical use: automating a lamp instead of replacing equipment I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV stick duplicates a function already covered by my 4K stick and Fire TV television, so familiar features do not give me a reason to choose it.",
    "The headphones and AirPods do not address a current need shown by my home entertainment and security purchases, and I have no established Apple-device use.",
    "The basic speakers and smaller display are less compelling because I would prioritize the Show 8's larger screen over adding several devices with overlapping uses."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend more Fire TV devices, even when they repeat capabilities I already own.",
    "My interest in connected-home equipment seems to have been stretched into interest in many Alexa devices without enough attention to what each would add."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a new device needs to add a useful capability rather than duplicate my streaming setup.",
    "My camera purchases make a compatible viewing display more relevant than another voice-only speaker.",
    "I would choose selectively among overlapping devices; liking the idea of Alexa control does not mean I need multiple speakers and displays."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected-home entertainment and security, but miss my preference for useful additions over duplicate devices."
}
